cases.name: Juggle the Performance
cases.text: Each player discards their hand, then conjures a duplicate of each of seven random cards from the library of the player to their right into their hand. The duplicates perpetually gain "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."

cases.name: Undercity Plunder
cases.text: Target opponent discards a card. Then they may discard an additional card. If they don't, conjure a duplicate of a random card from their library into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
